chapter: The Reveal (cavern, levels 51-60) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (#908): a warm soft-mallet vibraphone, motor off and the notes dampened short, playing one clearly articulated, hummable melody of constant quick eighth notes in the middle register, over a clean hollow-body jazz guitar comping soft chords, a walking upright bass and a gentle brushed snare - no piano to blur the lead (the owner's Jukebox note, 2026-10-16: it is not clear what instrument it is played on, a bit like a piano, too weak and shrill)
